_about: Cases for rules/vigil_rules.py test. Each case runs in its own wazuh-logtest session. A step sends `log` `times` times ({n} counts up across the case); `expect` lists the rule IDs allowed on the last of those lines, `not` lists IDs that must not fire on any of them. `live_only` cases can't run in logtest (533 compares agent command output over time) and are checked in the lab instead.
